quote: The shadows grow longer when you stay inside your head. You wander through rooms of your own design. Every memory is a ghost asking for a name. You search for comfort in places that broke you. The silence echoes louder than any forgotten promise. Let the night take what it was always owed. Sleep is the only honesty left in this world.
